answer_1.quote: We introduce the notion of structured summaries, or STRUCTSUM in short. STRUCTSUMs are derived by hierarchically organizing information and inducing semantic connections from an input text passage.

answer_2.quote: We propose an automatic way to assess the quality and the general usefulness of STRUCTSUMs introducing AUTO-QA coverage as proxy metric.

answer_3.quote: Recent instructions tuned models, such as,  and Chat-GPT (OpenAI, 2022) are shown to be strong evaluators. To avoid using external APIs, ;  fine-tune a smaller pretrained model to critic model responses.

answer_4.quote: We assessed the quality of generated structured data through manual human ratings. The study was conducted on 100 instances for mind maps.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate each instance as 'Good' or 'Bad' by checking the overall quality of the output. For both modalities, annotators were asked to check for factuality as well as the structural quality of the output.
